title: Eventual positivity conjecture for generalized Gregory coefficients
statement: Let $G_n^{(\ell)}(\mathbf{k})$ denote the generalized Gregory coefficients associated with a multiple polylogarithm of index $\mathbf{k}$ and positive integer order $\ell$, as defined by the Laurent expansion of the reciprocal of the corresponding $\ell$-th power. The conjecture asserts that for every admissible index $\mathbf{k}$ and every $\ell\in\mathbb{N}$, there exists $N=N(\mathbf{k},\ell)$ such that $G_n^{(\ell)}(\mathbf{k})>0$ for all $n\geq N$.
references: - [Rational Approximations for Reciprocals of Multiple Zeta Values and Trivariate Cauchy Numbers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.11072) — arXiv — Ce Xu, Jianqiang Zhao

progress.label: Open · progress reported
progress.tldr: A new paper confirms the conjecture for two important families, but the general question remains open.
progress.summary:
The problem asks whether generalized Gregory coefficients eventually have the conjectured positive sign. The general composition and order cases remain unresolved.

*[arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.11072)*

**September 2026 special-case confirmation**

Ce Xu and Jianqiang Zhao report that the eventual-sign conjecture is confirmed for polylogarithm and double-polylogarithm cases. This is a substantial partial advance, not a resolution of the general conjecture; the reported result is unverified in this scan.



Current status (as of September 2026): The polylogarithm and double-polylogarithm cases are claimed to be settled, while the general composition and order cases remain open.

*Caveats. The special-case confirmation is reported by the cited preprint but has not been independently verified here.*
